model_interpretation: Pilot-corridor nonlinear spatial/risk calibrator for Rudraprayag and Chamoli districts. It serves as hazard intelligence within the multi-hazard risk engine, rather than a universally validated landslide prediction model.
dataset_limitations: The pilot dataset consists of 20 curated base records across Rudraprayag and Chamoli. Augmented training data was generated from these records. The model is NOT validated for nationwide or general Uttarakhand deployment without extensive geotechnical and regional sensor data.

in_sample_training_fit.evaluation_type: TRAINING / IN-SAMPLE performance on augmented dataset

out_of_sample_validation.evaluation_type: Out-of-sample generalization estimate for the 20-village pilot corridor (~6.6% mean absolute error)
